rules: Two-Accent Rule: emerald = act/confirm; amber = money/chips/time
No-AI-Slop Rule: no purple-indigo gradients, cream beige canvases, or Inter-as-brand
Viewport Table Rule: never page-scroll to see cards or take actions; single horizontal action bar
Stakes-Are-Mono Rule: chips, pots, join codes, ledger figures use mono

motion.table: Framer Motion for deals/chips; purposeful, short; no bounce/elastic defaults

breakpoints.note: Table layout compresses seats/cards for narrow phones; action bar stays one horizontal row
